# Getting help

PlayGuard has one maintainer and no support channel outside this repository. Pick the
place that fits, and you will get an answer sooner.

| You want to… | Go to |
|---|---|
| Get back into a console: second-hand, forgotten PIN, locked out | The README's [Locked out?](https://github.com/JigSawFr/PlayGuard#locked-out-second-hand-console-forgotten-pin) first, then a [Locked out](https://github.com/JigSawFr/PlayGuard/issues/new?template=2-locked-out.yml) issue if it does not solve it |
| Ask how to do something, or talk an idea through | [Discussions](https://github.com/JigSawFr/PlayGuard/discussions) |
| Report something PlayGuard gets wrong | A [bug report](https://github.com/JigSawFr/PlayGuard/issues/new?template=1-bug.yml), with the diagnostic report (*Tools › Export a diagnostic report*) |
| Say a new firmware works, or does not | A [new firmware](https://github.com/JigSawFr/PlayGuard/issues/new?template=3-firmware.yml) issue |
| Share a play-timer block compared before and after a phone-app change | The *Console reports* category of [Discussions](https://github.com/JigSawFr/PlayGuard/discussions): the [roadmap](../ROADMAP.md#waiting-on-data-from-a-console) says which ones are wanted |
| Ask for something PlayGuard cannot do yet | A [feature request](https://github.com/JigSawFr/PlayGuard/issues/new?template=4-feature.yml) |
| Fix or add a translation | A [translation](https://github.com/JigSawFr/PlayGuard/issues/new?template=5-translation.yml) issue, or a pull request ([how](../CONTRIBUTING.md#translating-playguard)) |
| Report a way around the PIN, or another security problem | **Privately**, as the [security policy](../SECURITY.md) says. Never in a public issue |

Never post the PIN, the console's serial number or a full `config.json` in an issue or a
discussion: the diagnostic report leaves out the first two on purpose.

PlayGuard is not affiliated with Nintendo. Questions about the phone app, a Nintendo
account or a console that is not modded belong with Nintendo support.
